en_US: Oh, honey. You’re making a Pokédex?
You must be battling all kinds
of Pokémon.
Try using this TM for a change.
It’s Taunt.
Use it and the target Pokémon
can only use moves that do damage
to your Pokémon for a while.
Did you see the shrine that pays homage
to the protector?
This protector watches over the forest
from across time.
I think that it must be a
Grass-type Pokémon.
Cynthia: Well, hello, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}! I had a
feeling I might see you pass through
here. You’re probably wondering why
I’m even here?
Cynthia: I found an odd little artifact
that I felt you might somehow be able
to use. It’s known as an Odd Keystone.
Here, you can have it!
It might be worth taking it to the
Well in Azalea Town. I’ve heard of
sightings of a weird Pokémon there.
Cynthia: I hope it proves useful to
you. On a side note, you should come
visit the new archaelogical building
in Goldenrod City. It’s in the process
of replacing that old bike shop...
